decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 004 REV A, 002 REV A, 003 REV A, 006 REV A, 007 REV A, 005 REV A, 008 REV A, Existing and Proposed Site Plans, Existing Location and Block Plans, Flood Risk Assessment received 16.05.14) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of a new rear roof extension, installation of matching windows to the side roof extension with an additional window in turret roof, glass link from side roof extension to turret
